newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank said on Wednesday it was calling for bids on two-week securities repurchase bids at an unchanged, fixed rate of 3.0 percent and said it had left its key interest rates unchanged.
Bids have to be in by 1000 GMT on Friday, it added.
Last week, the central bank allotted 11.25 billion schillings in two-week repos, filling nine percent of bids.
Austria's discount rate stands at 2.50 percent, its Gomex money market rate at 3.40 percent and the Lombard emergency borrowing rate at 4.75 percent.
